title: Weekly Storage Rate by the Kind of Unit Held — Retrofit Projects
content:
# Weekly Storage Rate by the Kind of Unit Held

Not every unit ordered for a project under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects can be stored in the same place, and the weekly storage rate follows where the lot has to be held.

## Rule

Where the lot standing in storage is a chiller, a boiler or a cooling tower, which the company holds at a rented laydown yard rather than in its own warehouse, the weekly storage rate is the project's weekly storage charge together with the yard premium of **USD 120 per week**.

Where the lot standing in storage is an air handler, a makeup air unit or a VRF system, which is racked in the warehouse at oversize, the weekly storage rate is the project's weekly storage charge together with the rack premium of **USD 45 per week**.

For every other kind of unit the weekly storage rate is the project's weekly storage charge.

## Quick reference

| Kind of unit standing in storage | Where it is held | Added to the project's weekly storage charge |
|---|---|---|
| chiller, boiler, cooling tower | rented laydown yard | USD 120 per week |
| air handler, makeup air unit, VRF system | racked in the warehouse at oversize | USD 45 per week |
| rooftop unit, split system, heat pump, pump, exhaust fan, computer room unit and any other kind | the warehouse | nothing |

The kind of unit read is the kind recorded on the most recent stored delivery on the project.

## Worked rates (hypothetical)

On a project whose class carries a weekly storage charge of USD 195, a boiler standing in storage is rated at USD 315 per week and a makeup air unit at USD 240 per week, while a rooftop unit is rated at USD 195 per week.
